title: The Urban Unit Karachi AirGradient PM2.5 network (hourly aggregates)
original_publisher: The Urban Unit (sensor owner) with AirGradient (instrument provider)
access_platform: OpenAQ API v3 /sensors/{id}/hours (hourly aggregates computed by OpenAQ from raw sensor readings)
attribution: The Urban Unit / AirGradient sensor network, Karachi, accessed via OpenAQ (openaq.org), CC BY 4.0. Hourly values are OpenAQ aggregates; identify modifications; do not imply endorsement.
selection_rule: OpenAQ locations within 25 km of Karachi centre whose owner is The Urban Unit, provider AirGradient, licence CC BY 4.0, first data before 2025-07-15 and still reporting on 2026-10-20. PAQI-owned (Hawanama) locations are excluded to keep this source separate from PAQI.
measurement_caveat: Low-cost optical sensors; OpenAQ publishes values without humidity correction. Absolute levels are not equivalent to the reference-grade U.S. Consulate monitor.
